title: Man Runs Over His Friend With Car And Tries To Deny It
description:
On November 30, 2023, officers were dispatched in response to a hit-and-run incident. The suspect struck a person with the passenger-side door of his vehicle and fled the scene, leaving the victim critically injured. Here’s what happened when the police located the suspect. The man was taken to jail for further questioning regarding the incident and while coming out of the vehicle, he acted as if he just arrived on earth. He continued to insist that he wasn’t driving the car, even though witnesses had seen him driving. While transporting him, the officer noticed that the man had slumped in the seat and stopped the vehicle to help him sit back up. He had no patience to wait for the medical staff. One of the officers interrogated him. Shortly after, he began resisting the officers. He continued to argue that he had done nothing wrong. The man was charged with aggravated reckless driving, aggravated DUI, other traffic offences, failure to report a motor accident and resisting arrest.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
